units.§1: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Robust MDPs choose a policy against the worst transition model in an uncertainty set.
units.§2: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Theorem 2. Under (s,a)-rectangular uncertainty sets the robust MDP equals a zero-sum game in which nature picks the model adversarially at every step; the robust value is a minimax value.
units.§3: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Limitation. Without rectangularity the per-step game formulation does not hold and the problem can be computationally hard.
